title.zh: Democrats 'Move the Goalposts' on Clarity Act Hours Before Key Senate Vote
title.en: Democrats 'Move the Goalposts' on Clarity Act Hours Before Key Senate Vote

current_state.zh: The Clarity Act faces its first Senate cloture vote Tuesday, with Republicans accusing Democrats of moving the goalposts after a late counteroffer on ethics, developer protections, and the Ag title, while the White House signals little appetite for further negotiations.
